verdict.rationale: OpenHands itself functions as the built-in AI agent users delegate coding tasks to via natural language, evidenced by CLI mode ('type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback'), goal-setting UI flows, custom agent creation, and automation workflows triggered from Slack/GitHub. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports corroborating the delegation experience beyond first-party docs, and clearer detail on how task results/feedback loop back to the user in non-CLI modes.
